    • stop

      default boolean stop(SetupPlan plan, SetupApproval approval, SetupOptions options) throws IOException
      Stops the exact SHAFT-owned service represented by an approved plan.
      Parameters:
      plan - exact provider plan
      approval - approval bound to plan
      options - execution policy and owned roots
      Returns:
      true when an owned service was stopped
      Throws:
      IOException - when an owned service cannot be stopped safely

    • logs

      default String logs(SetupOptions options, SetupSelection selection, SetupPlatform platform, SetupArchitecture architecture) throws IOException
      Reads bounded logs owned by this provider without mutating the host.
      Parameters:
      options - execution policy and owned roots
      selection - exact profile selection
      platform - selected host platform
      architecture - selected host architecture
      Returns:
      log text, or an empty string when no owned logs exist
      Throws:
      IOException - when owned logs cannot be read safely
